name: Draw an observed contour
short_description: Draw the outer contour of one observed object in a continuous, recognisable line.
self_assessment: I can draw one observed object's contour without help in five minutes.
description: Draw the outer contour of one observed object in a continuous, recognisable line. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Draw the contour of a cup

builds_on.note: Fine motor control supports steady mark making.
